dedupe_keys.name: electricity demand data and solar generation data from plymouth uk

description: Electricity demand data and solar generation data from Plymouth. UK is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Singleton (University of Reading). This dataset was used in the Western Power Distribution Presumed Open Data competition in 2021. The data is provided under the Western Power Distribution Open Data Licence. Coverage: national (GB); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
